description.en: A 10-minute virtual nature walk along mountain pines and glacial streams. Video playback rate syncs smoothly with your steps.
description.fr: Une promenade virtuelle de 10 minutes à travers les pins de montagne et les ruisseaux glaciaires. La vitesse vidéo s'adapte à vos pas.
description.ar: مسار طبيعي افتراضي لمدة 10 دقائق بين صنوبر الجبال وجداول المياه الجليدية. تتزامن سرعة الفيديو بسلاسة مع خطواتك.

milestones.message: Quarter-way achieved! Keep that steady stride.
750 Steps! Almost at the summit overlook.

pointsOfInterest.title: Glacial Stream Crossing
pointsOfInterest.description: Clear meltwater flows down from the northern peaks, rich in pure alpine minerals.

pointsOfInterest.title: Historic Timber Bridge
pointsOfInterest.description: Built in 1912 by valley mountain guides connecting old high-altitude sheep pastures.

pointsOfInterest.title: Ancient Swiss Pine Grove
pointsOfInterest.description: Known as the King of the Alps, these hardy pines endure temperatures down to -40°C.

pointsOfInterest.title: Eagle Point Overlook
pointsOfInterest.description: Elevation 2,150 m. On clear mornings you can spot Golden Eagles circling the thermals.

pointsOfInterest.title: High Alpine Refuge
pointsOfInterest.description: A welcome sanctuary serving hot tea and warm sourdough bread to weary travelers.
